operatorAudience: Resolver Service Architect with hosted endpoint access.
Security Guard with resolver token access.
Regression Guard Agent running smoke commands.
Consultant UX Director reviewing pilot unlock after remote smoke passes.

shellSetup.expected: Base URL is HTTPS public staging endpoint, not localhost/private network.
Token is present only in protected shell/secret manager and never written to repo artifacts.
Approved CORS origin is exact NetSuite staging origin.
Blocked CORS origin is not in allowlist.

smokeCommandOrder.purpose: Rerun W76R with operator-provided env and confirm W76 sees remote env.
smokeCommandOrder.expectedPass: pilot_decision is not no_go_operator_env_missing and remote_smoke_executed becomes true.

smokeCommandOrder.purpose: Run W76 configured remote execution gate.
smokeCommandOrder.expectedPass: W76 reports remote_smoke_executed=true and pilot unlock criteria are satisfied.
smokeCommandOrder.expectedFail: W76 reports no_go_remote_config_missing or any failed health/auth/CORS/cache/live-smoke criterion.

smokeCommandOrder.purpose: Rerun W74 after remote smoke passes to decide consultant hosted-smoke eligibility.
smokeCommandOrder.expectedPass: Hosted resolver consultant smoke becomes eligible only after W73R remoteSmokeExecuted true.

smokeCommandOrder.purpose: Verify all resolver, classifier, no-write, and no-secret gates remain green.
smokeCommandOrder.expectedFail: Any failing gate blocks hosted resolver pilot.

expectedPassOutputs: Remote /health returns writeAuthority none, suiteScriptInvocation false, nllmAdvisoryOnly true.
Approved CORS preflight returns exact approved origin.
Blocked CORS preflight fails and does not echo blocked origin.
Second eligible resolve returns cacheHit true.
Approved live-site smoke returns zero false-confident-wrong and zero unsupported claims.
Trace/report show tokenConfigured true but never show the token value.
expectedFailOutputs: approved CORS preflight does not return exact allowed origin.
blocked CORS preflight echoes blocked origin.
false-confident-wrong count is greater than zero.
unsupported claim count is greater than zero.
raw token/header/cookie value appears in any trace or report.
noSecretHandlingRules: Do not paste the resolver token into chat, repo files, reports, trace samples, screenshots, or README content.
Do not commit shell exports containing secrets.
Do not print Authorization, cookie, or X-IDB-Resolver-Token values.
If the token appears in any artifact, stop and rotate the token before continuing.
Endpoint URL and origins may be non-secret, but still validate them before smoke.
rollbackSteps: Unset IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_BASE_URL and IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_TOKEN in the operator shell.
Clear drawer endpoint/token settings before consultant pilot.
Set hosted resolver pilot toggle to disabled.
Use local fallback only for development smoke, not as proof of hosted readiness.
Rerun npm run harness:remote-resolver-pilot-toggle-decision and confirm hostedResolverPilotEnabled false.
Export trace showing rollback decision with no raw secrets.

pilotUnlockDecisionTree.action: Fix endpoint/token/origin config and rerun W76R.
Fix hosted resolver deployment or security policy.

pilotUnlockDecisionTree.condition: Approved live-site smoke has false-confident-wrong or unsupported claims.
Any raw token/header/cookie appears in trace/report.
pilotUnlockDecisionTree.action: Rotate token, delete unsafe artifact, rerun no-secret validation.

pilotUnlockDecisionTree.condition: W73R remoteSmokeExecuted true, all remote checks pass, no secrets leak, full preflight passes, and W74 returns consultant smoke eligible.
pilotUnlockDecisionTree.action: Proceed to hosted-only consultant smoke gate; do not enable production traffic yet.

bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W79: Hosted Resolver Consultant Smoke Unlock Gate
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W79: Hosted Resolver Consultant Smoke Unlock Gate. Use the W78 runbook result to decide whether the hosted resolver can proceed to consultant-shaped smoke. If W76R has remoteSmokeExecuted true and W74 returns hosted consultant smoke eligible, run hosted-only Plan/Review/ROI/Run/Trace smoke with concise resolver status, evidence coverage, rollback guidance, no-secret trace checks, and no-write/no-SuiteScript/N/LLM-advisory-only gates. If not, keep pilot no-go and output the exact failed unlock criteria. Keep notes story-only and blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout as insufficient evidence with no confident guesses. Output consultant smoke results or no-go criteria, W79 report, validator gates, and best next Codex prompt.
